using System;
using System.IO;
using System.Linq;
using Akiiray.VRCAvatarLiteKitPlus;
using nadena.dev.ndmf;
using nadena.dev.ndmf.platform;
using UnityEditor;
using UnityEditor.Animations;
using UnityEngine;
using VRC.SDK3.Avatars.Components;
using VRC.SDK3.Avatars.ScriptableObjects;
using VRC.SDK3.Dynamics.Contact.Components;
using VRC.SDKBase;
using P = VRC.SDK3.Avatars.ScriptableObjects.VRCExpressionParameters;
using T = VRC.SDK3.Avatars.ScriptableObjects.VRCExpressionParameters.ValueType;
using Object = UnityEngine.Object;

public static class LiteKitContract
{
    private const string Prefix = "LiteKit_PC_";
    private const string Index = Prefix + "Sync_Index";
    private const string LayerName = "LiteKit Parameter Compressor [4ED03D94]";
    private static string folder;
    private static int tested;

    public static void Run()
    {
        try
        {
            folder = "Assets/Fixture_" + Guid.NewGuid().ToString("N");
            Directory.CreateDirectory(folder);
            AssetDatabase.Refresh();
            Case("Float", 5, 0, 1, 2, 5);
            Case("Int", 0, 5, 1, 2, 5);
            Case("Mixed", 4, 3, 2, 5, 4, repeat: true);
            Case("Zero", 0, 0, 1, 0, 0);
            Case("Single", 1, 0, 1, 0, 0);
            Case("MaxUseful", 32, 0, 999, 31, 2);
            Case("IndexMax", 255, 0, 1, 2, 255);
            Case("IndexOverflow", 256, 0, 1, 0, 0, expectError: true);
            Case("BudgetOverflow", 34, 0, 999, 0, 0, expectError: true);
            Case("ReservedExpression", 4, 0, 1, 0, 0, (d,c) =>
                d.expressionParameters.parameters = d.expressionParameters.parameters.Append(Param(Index, T.Int)).ToArray(), true);
            Case("ReservedFxSameType", 4, 0, 1, 0, 0, (d,c) =>
                c.AddParameter(Index, AnimatorControllerParameterType.Int), true);
            Case("ReservedFxWrongType", 4, 0, 1, 0, 0, (d,c) =>
                c.AddParameter(Index, AnimatorControllerParameterType.Trigger), true);
            Case("WrongTargetType", 4, 0, 1, 0, 0, (d,c) =>
                c.AddParameter("F0", AnimatorControllerParameterType.Int), true);
            Case("WrongIsLocalType", 4, 0, 1, 0, 0, (d,c) =>
                c.AddParameter("IsLocal", AnimatorControllerParameterType.Float), true);
            Case("ExistingLayer", 4, 0, 1, 0, 0, (d,c) => c.AddLayer(LayerName), true);
            Case("TimingTarget", 4, 0, 1, 0, 0, (d,c) =>
                new GameObject("__LiteKit_PC_Timing__").transform.SetParent(d.transform), true);
            Case("DuplicateExpression", 4, 0, 1, 0, 0, (d,c) =>
                d.expressionParameters.parameters = d.expressionParameters.parameters.Append(Param("F0", T.Int)).ToArray(), true);
            Case("CustomBitWidth", 5, 0, 1, 2, 4, (d,c) =>
            {
                d.expressionParameters.parameters[0].bitWidth = 4;
                d.expressionParameters.parameters[1].useCustomLerpDuration = true;
                d.expressionParameters.parameters[1].customLerpDuration = 0.15f;
            });
            Case("ReservedWithoutTargets", 0, 0, 1, 0, 0, (d,c) => c.AddParameter(Index, AnimatorControllerParameterType.Int), true);
            Case("Disabled", 5, 0, 1, 0, 0, (d,c) => d.GetComponent<LiteKitParameterCompressor>().EnableCompression = false);
            Case("Contact", 5, 0, 1, 2, 4, (d,c) =>
                new GameObject("Contact").transform.SetParent(d.transform));
            Debug.Log("LITEKIT_CONTRACT_PASS " + tested);
            EditorApplication.Exit(0);
        }
        catch (Exception e)
        {
            Debug.LogException(e);
            EditorApplication.Exit(1);
        }
    }

    private static P.Parameter Param(string name, T type) => new P.Parameter
    {
        name = name, valueType = type, defaultValue = 1, saved = true, networkSynced = true
    };

    private static void Case(string name, int floats, int ints, int requested, int channelsWithIndex, int batches,
        Action<VRCAvatarDescriptor, AnimatorController> configure = null, bool expectError = false, bool repeat = false)
    {
        var root = new GameObject(name);
        var component = root.AddComponent<LiteKitParameterCompressor>();
        component.SyncChannelCount = requested;
        var descriptor = root.GetComponent<VRCAvatarDescriptor>();
        var fxPath = folder + "/" + name + ".controller";
        var paramPath = folder + "/" + name + ".asset";
        var prefabPath = folder + "/" + name + ".prefab";
        var fx = AnimatorController.CreateAnimatorControllerAtPath(fxPath);
        var expressions = ScriptableObject.CreateInstance<P>();
        expressions.parameters = Enumerable.Range(0, floats).Select(i => Param("F" + i, T.Float))
            .Concat(Enumerable.Range(0, ints).Select(i => Param("I" + i, T.Int))).ToArray();
        AssetDatabase.CreateAsset(expressions, paramPath);
        descriptor.customExpressions = true;
        descriptor.expressionParameters = expressions;
        descriptor.customizeAnimationLayers = true;
        descriptor.baseAnimationLayers = new[] {new VRCAvatarDescriptor.CustomAnimLayer
            {type = VRCAvatarDescriptor.AnimLayerType.FX, animatorController = fx}};
        configure?.Invoke(descriptor, fx);
        if (name == "Contact") root.transform.Find("Contact").gameObject.AddComponent<VRCContactReceiver>().parameter = "F0";
        EditorUtility.SetDirty(expressions);
        var prefab = PrefabUtility.SaveAsPrefabAsset(root, prefabPath);
        Object.DestroyImmediate(root);
        AssetDatabase.SaveAssets();
        var paths = new[] {fxPath, paramPath, prefabPath};
        var sourceBytes = paths.Select(File.ReadAllBytes).ToArray();
        var sourceExpression = EditorJsonUtility.ToJson(expressions);
        var sourceParameters = fx.parameters.Select(p => p.name).ToArray();
        var sourceLayers = fx.layers.Select(l => l.name).ToArray();

        for (var i = 0; i < (repeat ? 2 : 1); i++)
        {
            var clone = Object.Instantiate(prefab);
            var report = AvatarProcessor.ProcessAvatar(clone, AmbientPlatform.CurrentPlatform);
            Assert(report.Successful != expectError, name + ": expected build status");
            var result = clone.GetComponent<VRCAvatarDescriptor>();
            if (!expectError)
            {
                var sync = result.expressionParameters.parameters.Where(p => p.name.StartsWith(Prefix)).ToArray();
                Assert(sync.Length == channelsWithIndex, name + ": channel count");
                Assert(sync.All(p => p.networkSynced && !p.saved && p.defaultValue == 0), name + ": channel flags");
                var output = (AnimatorController)result.baseAnimationLayers.Single(x => x.type == VRCAvatarDescriptor.AnimLayerType.FX).animatorController;
                var layers = output.layers.Where(l => l.name == LayerName).ToArray();
                Assert(layers.Length == (batches == 0 ? 0 : 1), name + ": layer count");
                if (batches != 0) CheckLayer(name, batches, layers[0].stateMachine);
                Assert(result.expressionParameters.parameters.Take(floats + ints).All(p => p.saved && p.defaultValue == 1),
                    name + ": original parameter attributes");
                if (name == "Contact") Assert(result.expressionParameters.parameters.First().networkSynced, "Contact stays synced");
                if (name == "CustomBitWidth")
                {
                    var entries = result.expressionParameters.parameters;
                    Assert(entries[0].networkSynced && entries[0].bitWidth == 4, "custom width stays directly synced");
                    Assert(!entries[1].networkSynced && entries[1].useCustomLerpDuration && entries[1].customLerpDuration == 0.15f,
                        "new SDK attributes survive the expression asset clone");
                    Assert(result.expressionParameters.CalcTotalCost() == 20, "SDK totals include 4-bit originals");
                }
            }
            Object.DestroyImmediate(clone);
            AssetDatabase.SaveAssets();
            Assert(sourceExpression == EditorJsonUtility.ToJson(expressions), name + ": source expression reference");
            Assert(sourceParameters.SequenceEqual(fx.parameters.Select(p => p.name)) &&
                sourceLayers.SequenceEqual(fx.layers.Select(l => l.name)), name + ": source FX reference");
            for (var n = 0; n < paths.Length; n++)
                Assert(sourceBytes[n].SequenceEqual(File.ReadAllBytes(paths[n])), name + ": source bytes " + paths[n]);
        }
        tested++;
        Debug.Log("LITEKIT_CASE_PASS " + name);
    }

    private static void CheckLayer(string name, int batches, AnimatorStateMachine machine)
    {
        Assert(machine.states.Length == 3 + 2 * batches, name + ": state count");
        for (var i = 1; i <= batches; i++)
        {
            var local = machine.states.Single(s => s.state.name == "Batch_" + i).state;
            var remote = machine.states.Single(s => s.state.name == "Set_B" + i).state;
            var encoder = local.behaviours.OfType<VRCAvatarParameterDriver>().Single();
            var decoder = remote.behaviours.OfType<VRCAvatarParameterDriver>().Single();
            Assert(encoder.localOnly && !decoder.localOnly && local.motion.averageDuration >= 0.09f, name + ": timing / branch");
            Assert(encoder.parameters.Count == decoder.parameters.Count + 1, name + ": driver count");
            var last = encoder.parameters.Last();
            Assert(last.type == VRC_AvatarParameterDriver.ChangeType.Set && last.name == Index && last.value == i,
                name + ": Index must be set last");
            for (var j = 0; j < decoder.parameters.Count; j++)
            {
                var send = encoder.parameters[j];
                var receive = decoder.parameters[j];
                Assert(send.type == VRC_AvatarParameterDriver.ChangeType.Copy && send.type == receive.type &&
                    send.name == receive.source && send.source == receive.name, name + ": inverse Copy");
            }
        }
    }

    private static void Assert(bool ok, string failure)
    {
        if (!ok) throw new InvalidOperationException(failure);
    }
}
